title: DOE using the alien motif as cover

tellings.quote: There's something going on with high energy physics, the Department of Energy, I think, throwing people off actually with this sort of alien motif,

plain: Michels suggests that the US Department of Energy, the government body that oversees nuclear and high-energy physics research, may be using the idea of aliens to throw people off. Speaking for himself in a 2026 episode, he says "there's something going on with high energy physics," and that the department may be hiding it behind "this sort of alien motif." If so, some UFO stories would be cover for secret physics work.
